text: Samaria [1] has become guilty,for she has rebelled against her God.They shall fall by the sword,their infants shall be dashed to pieces, [AA]their pregnant women shall be ripped open. [AB]
Return, Israel, to the Lord, your God;you have stumbled because of your iniquity.
Take with you words,and return to the Lord;Say to him, "Forgive all iniquity,and take what is good.Let us offer the fruit of our lips. [AC]
t[2] Assyria will not save us,nor will we mount horses; [AD]We will never again say, 'Our god,'to the work of our hands;for in you the orphan finds compassion." [AE]
I will heal their apostasy,I will love them freely;for my anger is turned away from them.
I will be like the dew for Israel: [AF]he will blossom like the lily;He will strike root like the Lebanon cedar,
and his shoots will go forth. [AG]His splendor will be like the olive treeand his fragrance like Lebanon cedar. [AH]
Again they will live in his shade;they will raise grain,They will blossom like the vine,and his renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
Ephraim! What more have I to do with idols? [AI]I have humbled him, but I will take note of him.I am like a verdant cypress tree. [3]From me fruit will be found for you!
t[4] Who is wise enough to understand these things? [AJ]Who is intelligent enough to know them?Straight are the paths of the Lord, [AK]the just walk in them, [AL]but sinners stumble in them.
